objective:
Deterministic clean-up of the question reader's untrusted words in core-domain LookupService, driven by the first Pixel 10 Pro question recording (core-testing/src/test/resources/semantic-corpus/recordings/question-device-latest.json; report via ./gradlew :core-testing:test --tests '*QuestionRegressionGateTest' -> core-testing/build/reports/semantic-corpus/question-device.md). Same spirit as the tag policy repairs of ADR-039 amendment TG1.4b: program logic decides, never the model; no prompt change, no re-recording. Also one scorer refinement in core-testing QuestionReplay.

Read first: core-domain lookup/LookupService.kt (ask, scopeOf, browseOrNothing, normalizeForMatch), QuestionKindDetector.kt, QuestionScope.kt, HistoryLookup.kt (LookupTarget.fromResolutions), tagging/TagResolver.kt (Exact/Near/New/Empty, verb match, synonyms), naming/NameNormalizer.kt, lookup tests (LookupServiceTest, QuestionKindDetectorTest); core-testing corpus/QuestionReplay.kt, QuestionCorpusModel.kt, QuestionCorpusOracleTest.kt, QuestionReplayScorerTest.kt, QuestionRegressionGateTest.kt, the question corpus and the device recording named above (synthetic questions; never print model words in test output).

What the model did (recorded answers: subject / action / date words):
- "When did I last change the furnace filter?" -> furnace filter / change / "last"; "When was the last time I walked the dogs?" -> dogs / walked / "last time"; the same "last" for the yard, grass and chlorine last-time questions. Result today: dates NOT_UNDERSTOOD and the "couldn't tell which dates" note on a plain last-time question.
- "What did I do last week?" -> I / do / "last week"; "Show me what I did in September" -> I / did; "What did I get done this month?" -> I / get done. Result: NotEnoughHistory instead of Browse.
- "What did I do around the holidays?" -> holidays / do / "around the holidays".
- "When did I last clean something?" -> something / clean.
- "When did I last add chlorine?" -> chlorine / add; "How often do I change the oil?" -> oil / change; "Did I ever change the oil in the truck?" -> oil / change; "How much chlorine did I add to the hot tub last week?" -> chlorine / add. The catalog has actions "add chlorine" and "change oil". Result: NotEnoughHistory.
- "When did I last change the furnace filter?" -> furnace filter / change; "Have I ever replaced the furnace filter?" -> furnace filter / replace. Catalog: subject furnace, action change filter. Result: closest furnace, action unset (WRONG_ACTION).

PART A -- core-domain lookup: a new internal object `QuestionWords` in the lookup package, called by LookupService.ask right after a successful extraction and before scopeOf and tag resolution; pure; the catalog is passed in; logs nothing. Every rule only REMOVES or RECOMBINES the user's own words; nothing is invented. Apply in this order on normalized words (NameNormalizer.normalize plus curly apostrophe to plain):
1. Date words that are only the 'last time / ever' phrasing are absent: normalized date words in {"last", "last time", "the last time", "ever", "at all", "before"} -> null. ("last week", "the last month" etc. are untouched.)
2. Placeholder subject is absent: subject in {"i", "me", "my", "myself", "we", "us", "it", "something", "anything", "everything", "stuff", "thing", "things"} -> null, unless it resolves TagResolution.Exact against the catalog.
3. Subject made only of date words is absent: when date words are present (after rule 1 and the existing occurs-in-question check) and every word of the subject occurs in them -> null, unless it resolves Exact.
4. Generic action is absent: action in {"do", "did", "done", "doing", "get done", "got done", "do anything", "do anything with", "do something", "do something with", "did anything", "work on", "worked on"} -> null, unless it resolves Exact.
5. Re-join: the subject resolves New (no tag at all), an action is given, and "<action> <subject>" resolves Exact or Near as an ACTION -> action = that joined phrase, subject = null. ("add" + "chlorine" -> "add chlorine"; "change" + "oil" -> "change oil".)
6. Re-split: the subject has 2+ words and does not resolve Exact, an action is given, the subject minus its last word resolves Exact as a SUBJECT, and "<action> <last word>" resolves Exact or Near as an ACTION -> subject = the shorter words, action = the joined phrase. ("furnace filter" + "change" -> "furnace" + "change filter"; "furnace filter" + "replace" -> "furnace" + "replace filter" only if TagResolver resolves that Exact or Near, e.g. via its synonym rule; otherwise the rule does not apply.)
After the clean-up the rest of ask() is unchanged: browseOrNothing sees the cleaned subject/action (so "What did I do last week?" -> Browse), and the date-word occurs-in-question check runs on the cleaned date words. Copy the QuestionCandidate rather than mutating. Update the LookupService class KDoc order-of-steps and the file comment (name the rules briefly). Unit tests (new QuestionWordsTest plus LookupServiceTest additions): every rule incl. its 'unless Exact' guard, rule order, a case where none applies, and the end-to-end examples above through LookupService with a small fake catalog; all existing lookup tests unchanged and passing.

PART B -- core-testing scorer refinement (QuestionReplay.kt + tests): an ANSWER whose subject is UNSET while the case expects one of subjectIds is still CORRECT (not WRONG_SUBJECT) when the expected action is set, the resolved action is acceptable, and in the case's fixture every entry with that resolved action has a subject in the expected subjectIds (the answer selects exactly the same entries; e.g. "add chlorine" is only ever logged for the hot tub). Otherwise unchanged. Test both directions in QuestionReplayScorerTest. Do NOT change question-corpus.json (its hash pins the recording) or any recording/baseline file.

PART C -- measure: run ./gradlew :core-testing:test (incl. QuestionRegressionGateTest, which writes question-device.md) and report the new class totals and every non-CORRECT case id with its codes. QuestionCorpusOracleTest must still pass with all cases CORRECT. Report counts, ids and codes only, never model words.

Rules: model output stays untrusted; the model never produces a date, count or answer (ADR-011/051/052); rules only drop or recombine the user's words and every recombined phrase must resolve to an EXISTING tag via TagResolver (never create or guess one); no logging (AGENTS.md #11); no change to TemporalRangeResolver, TagResolver, QuestionKindDetector, HistoryLookup ranking, stats, core-ai or the app.
non_goals: No prompt or core-ai change and no re-recording.
No change to question-corpus.json, recordings or baselines (the orchestrator writes question-baseline.json).
No change to TagResolver, TemporalRangeResolver, QuestionKindDetector, HistoryLookup, stats, app-phone.
acceptance_criteria: QuestionWords implements rules 1-6 in order with the 'unless Exact' guards; every recombined phrase resolves to an existing tag via TagResolver; LookupService applies it before scope and tag resolution; KDoc updated.
Unit tests cover each rule, its guard, ordering, no-op, and the end-to-end examples; all existing lookup tests pass unchanged.
QuestionReplay treats an unset subject as acceptable only under the same-entries condition; tests both ways.
question-corpus.json, recordings and baselines unchanged; QuestionCorpusOracleTest still all CORRECT.
Replay of the committed Pixel recording reported (class totals + non-CORRECT ids and codes).
No file outside write_paths is changed.
